name_en: Matsutake gohan — rice cooked with prized Tanba matsutake mushrooms
summary_ja: 香り高い「丹波マツタケ」を薄く切り、米と昆布出汁で炊き込むごはん。松林の荒廃で戦前より生産量が大きく減り、いまは高級食材として料亭や割烹で秋の一皿として供されることが多いという。
summary_en: Fragrant Tanba matsutake mushrooms are sliced thin and cooked into rice with kelp dashi. With pine forests declining and yields far below prewar levels, the mushroom has become a costly delicacy said to appear as an autumn dish mostly at ryotei and traditional restaurants today.
source_title: 松茸ごはん 京都府 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Kuri gohan — rice cooked with sweet Tanba chestnuts and a touch of salt
summary_ja: 大粒で甘みの強い「丹波くり」を米と塩少々で炊き込む秋のごはん。栗は劣化が早いため落下後すぐの調理が肝心とされ、平安時代から貴族に献上されてきたと伝わる丹波の名産を存分に味わう一品。
summary_en: Large, sweet Tanba chestnuts are cooked into rice with a touch of salt for an autumn dish. Because the chestnuts spoil quickly once fallen, cooking them right away is said to matter — a way to savor a Tanba specialty said to have been offered to Heian-era nobles.
source_title: 栗ごはん 京都府 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
